meta.description: Moi Président, Cosmic Studio's mobile game: a satirical simulation of a presidential campaign, with fictional characters and figures. Support and legal information.

moiPresident.title: Moi Président
moiPresident.lead: A satirical simulation game. The characters and the parties are fictional and parodic; the scores come from a simulation: they are fictional figures. The game is not affiliated with any governmental organisation, party or activist association, and has no link with any candidate or polling institute. No voting instruction.
moiPresident.stores_soon: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play
